clue.text: Bash head of poor female rodent

parts.note: to have a bash at something is to have a go

indicators.note: the head of a word is its opening letter, here of poor

parts.note: her is the female pronoun

explanation.surface: Someone thumps the chief of a poor female rodent.
explanation.definitionFit: A North American burrowing animal with cheek pouches, the gopher is a kind of rodent.

clue.text: Info on ordinary policemen's ultimate role in ethnic cleansing

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
CID, the Criminal Investigation Department, is the British plain-clothes detective branch

indicators.note: ultimate means last, so only the closing letter of role is taken

explanation.surface: Intelligence on detectives' final part in a campaign of ethnic cleansing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is a link word placing the pieces one after another.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethnic cleansing is a euphemism for the deliberate destruction of a people, close in sense to mass murder of a group.

clue.text: If German is supporting overthrow of EU policy he won't use violence

indicators.note: in a down clue the piece that supports sits underneath, so the If-German-is part comes below
to overthrow is to turn upside down, so in a down clue the letters for EU policy read upwards

parts.note: CAP is the European Union's Common Agricultural Policy
taken as written
ist is the German word for is

explanation.surface: A man who rejects violence because German membership underpins the toppling of a European policy.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who refuses to use force on principle is a pacifist; the clue's he is a description of such a person.

clue.text: First Lady's books reveal affair

parts.note: Eve was the first woman in Genesis
NT is the New Testament, a group of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: A President's wife's diaries expose an illicit relationship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First Lady' suggests a President's wife, but it is Eve, the first woman; 'reveal' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: An affair in the sense of an occurrence or happening is an event.

clue.text: Chap set about pursuing diamonds in frozen waste

indicators.note: pursuing means following, so the rearranged part comes after the diamonds

parts.note: ice is slang for diamonds

indicators.note: about suggests moving letters around, so chap and set are mixed up

parts.note: he is a male pronoun, standing for a chap
taken as written

explanation.surface: A man setting off after jewels in a polar wilderness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns HE plus SET into SHEET.
explanation.definitionFit: A vast expanse of glacial ice covering land, such as Antarctica's, is a frozen wasteland.

clue.text: Extraordinary rendition case is ready for transportation

indicators.note: extraordinary means out of the ordinary, so the letters of the following words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A case of extraordinary rendition, prisoners spirited abroad, primed for shipping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Extraordinary rendition' is the phrase for secretly transferring suspects abroad; here 'Extraordinary' is the anagram signal and 'is' a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods packed into standard shipping boxes for transport by sea, rail or road have been containerised.

clue.text: Bear genus could be broken down into these groups

indicators.note: breaking something down suggests splitting and reassembling, so bear and genus are rearranged

explanation.surface: A taxonomy note: the bear genus can be divided into smaller categories.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' is a link word; the clue nearly reads as a definition throughout, since subgenera are what a genus is split into.
explanation.definitionFit: Subgenera are the taxonomic ranks between genus and species, the groups a genus can be split into.

clue.text: With receding hair, he's finally long in the tooth, outwardly at least

definitions.text: in the tooth, outwardly at least

indicators.note: receding means going back, so the word for hair is read backwards

parts.note: a mane is a long head of hair

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of he's

explanation.surface: An ageing man, his hairline retreating, is getting on in years.
explanation.walkthrough: 'long in the tooth' means old, but the phrase splits: 'long' gives L and 'in the tooth, outwardly at least' is the definition; 'With' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: The hard glossy coating on the outside of a tooth is its enamel, its outermost layer.

clue.text: Bird infection

definitions.meaning: a songbird with a speckled breast
a yeast infection caused by candida

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a speckled songbird and a fungal infection of the mouth or genitals.

clue.text: Obliging husband adopted suitable position

indicators.note: adopted means taken in, so the husband goes inside

parts.note: an obliging person is nice

explanation.surface: A helpful spouse took up a fitting post.
explanation.definitionFit: A niche is a role or place that suits someone exactly.

clue.text: Tory in Lab disguise?

indicators.note: a disguise changes appearance, so the letters of tory, in and lab are rearranged

explanation.surface: A jibe at a Labour leader as a Conservative dressed up as Labour.
explanation.walkthrough: Lab is short for Labour; the whole clue is the jibe that this Labour Prime Minister was a Tory in disguise.
explanation.definitionFit: Critics called the New Labour Prime Minister a closet Conservative, a Tory wearing Labour colours.

clue.text: Suffering of reptile and feline?

parts.note: a tortoise is a shelled reptile, made possessive by of
hell is torment or suffering

explanation.surface: Asks about the torment of a slow reptile and of a cat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of reptile' gives TORTOISE'S, the possessive. A tortoiseshell is a cat with mottled black and ginger fur.
explanation.definitionFit: A cat with a mottled black, orange and brown coat is called a tortoiseshell.

clue.text: Buffet California with fair wind from the east

parts.note: CA is the postal abbreviation for California
a fete is a fair or gala

indicators.note: in an across answer, coming from the east means going right to left, so the word for wind is reversed

parts.note: air is a light wind or breeze

explanation.surface: California is battered by a fair breeze coming from the east.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Buffet' looks like a verb (to batter) but is the noun for a self-service restaurant; 'with' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A buffet in the sense of a self-service eating place is a cafeteria.

clue.text: Pitchers were smashed to third base

indicators.note: smashed means broken into pieces, so the letters of were are rearranged
third points to the third letter of base

explanation.surface: Baseball pitchers were thrashed on the way to third base.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pitchers' and 'third base' paint baseball, but pitchers are jugs; 'to' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Ewers are large jugs, and a pitcher is another name for a jug.

clue.text: "Do it!" I snapped, angry and frustrated

indicators.note: angry suggests agitation, so the letters of the quoted words are churned

explanation.surface: An irritated person barks an order, frustrated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Being frustrated in a hope or plan is to be let down, that is, disappointed.

clue.text: Email Copt about ancient Egyptian dynasty

definitions.note: the definition names a noun but the answer is the adjective, as in the dynasty of that name

indicators.note: about suggests turning around, so the letters of email and copt are rearranged

explanation.surface: Send an Egyptian Christian a message concerning the pharaohs of old.
explanation.walkthrough: A Copt is an Egyptian Christian, which helps the surface; 'about' looks like 'concerning' but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek-descended rulers of Egypt from Alexander's death to Cleopatra were the Ptolemaic dynasty.

clue.text: Shrink is repressed by smaller version of self

indicators.note: being repressed by something means held down within it, so is goes inside

parts.note: Mini-Me is the pint-sized clone of Dr Evil in the Austin Powers films
taken as written

explanation.surface: A psychiatrist is held back by a smaller copy of himself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shrink' tempts as a psychiatrist, pairing with 'repressed' and 'self', but it is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To shrink something is to make it smaller, to reduce it to the least amount.

clue.text: GMT doesn't start in the interim!

indicators.note: the start of the full name is dropped, leaving its later words

parts.note: GMT stands for Greenwich Mean Time

explanation.surface: Greenwich time hasn't kicked off yet, so we wait.
explanation.walkthrough: The start removed is the whole first word, Greenwich; 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: The interim is the time between two events, also called the meantime.

clue.text: Tory-Liberal, not vice versa

indicators.note: liberal means free and loose, so the following letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Tory turned Liberal, though not the other way round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tory' and 'Liberal' both look like parties, but only Tory is the definition; Liberal is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A Tory is a member of Britain's Conservative Party.

clue.text: Leader of Pakistani peacekeepers gets shot in the province

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its opening letter, here of Pakistani

parts.note: UN peacekeeping forces come from the United Nations
a jab is an injection or shot

explanation.surface: A Pakistani commander of peacekeeping troops is wounded in a region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shot' suggests gunfire but means an injection; 'gets' and 'in the' are link words. The answer is a province of Pakistan (and a state of India).
explanation.definitionFit: This province is Pakistan's most populous administrative region, centred on Lahore.

clue.text: She transfixes Middlesex town

definitions.meaning: one who pins things in place
a suburb in north-west London, in the old county of Middlesex

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a person who fixes things with pins and a north-west London suburb, formerly in Middlesex.

clue.text: Single European Union

parts.note: a unit is a single thing

explanation.surface: Single European Union evokes Brussels-speak for one federal Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a trade union: Unite is Britain's largest trade union.
explanation.definitionFit: Unite is the name of a large British trade union, formed from a merger in 2007.

clue.text: The state of being mistrusted a bit

definitions.meaning: the condition of being doubted or thought guilty
a slight trace, as in a hint of garlic

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both distrust felt about someone and a tiny trace or hint of something.

clue.text: Angry pirates are circling!

indicators.note: pirates circling something surround it, so the answer sits inside the word pirates

explanation.surface: Furious buccaneers are surrounding us!
explanation.definitionFit: Irate is a direct synonym of angry, meaning furious.

clue.text: Group of thugs from Africa and Japan knock off good dope and tobacco

parts.note: J is the international vehicle code for Japan

indicators.note: knocking off removes a part, so the good letter comes off the word for dope

parts.note: ganja is cannabis, dope
weed is slang for tobacco

explanation.surface: African and Japanese gangsters dropping decent drugs and cigarettes.
explanation.walkthrough: Knocking G off GANJA leaves ANJA; 'and' (twice) are link words. The Janjaweed are the militias in Sudan's Darfur conflict.
explanation.definitionFit: The Janjaweed are armed Arab militias in Sudan notorious for atrocities in Darfur, so African thugs.

clue.text: Tory-Liberal [ibid] quota for Defence

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Tory-Liberal [ibid] quota for Defence': ALIBI is hidden in 'Liberal ibid' (quota for = hidden indicator, Defence = definition), but the printed square brackets round 'ibid' cannot be quoted in a wordplay leaf, so the hidden-word fodder cannot be written

clue.text: Nick phone to make tweet?

parts.note: both nick and bird are British slang, nick for prison and bird for a prison term
to phone someone is to call them

explanation.surface: Ring the police station to send a social-media message?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nick' suggests stealing or a police station; 'to make' is a link phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A tweet is the chirp a small bird makes, a kind of song or call.

clue.text: Setback as son lost honour

indicators.note: lost means gone missing, so the letter for son is dropped

parts.note: a reverse is a setback or defeat

explanation.surface: A setback when a son lost his good name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: To revere someone is to honour them deeply, holding them in great respect.
